name: civicconnect-ai
description: CivicConnect AI - Multilingual citizen grievance chatbot platform for Karnataka

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,ai,frontend -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix ai-service" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix ai-service && npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.db:setup: node backend/scripts/ensure-db.mjs && npm run db:migrate --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && python3 -m venv ai-service/.venv && ai-service/.venv/bin/pip install -r ai-service/requirements.txt
